snippet.title: [Traymon World] Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Traymon World launches on Steam on November 26, 2026!

Tiny monsters. Big adventures. Right on your taskbar.
Collect 80 unique monsters, combine their skills and synergies, and build your ultimate party. While you work, study, or take a break, your monsters keep exploring and battling.

Free to play. Wishlist now on Steam!

Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5045040/?l=english

#TraymonWorld #IdleGame #IndieGame
